title: DhwaniTTS v1.7 Major Update
short_msg: TTS Navigation Drawer, Real-Time Language Toggles, Louder Audio & Fixed Updates!
full_msg:
New DhwaniTTS v1.7 is live! Highlights:
1. Top-left TTS Navigation Drawer with Real-Time Active Mix Language Toggles.
2. Fixed Default Voice & Auto TTS multilingual selection.
3. Louder, clearer audio with RMS + Soft Limiter boost.
4. Better TalkBack speech rate sync.
5. Permanent signing key so future updates install smoothly without errors.

Note: Please uninstall the old version once before installing this update.
